tools.name: Apple's Command Line Tools
tools.what: Includes Python 3, which Trans Coded runs on. Free from Apple.
steps: Open Terminal (Applications › Utilities) and paste this, then press Return:
Click Install, then Agree. It takes 5 to 15 minutes. If it says they're already installed, you're done.

tools.name: HandBrakeCLI
tools.what: Shrinks rips to a sensible size. It's the command-line version: the regular HandBrake app doesn't count.
steps: On HandBrake's download page, under Command Line Version, download the macOS file.
Open it and drag HandBrakeCLI into your Applications folder.

tools.name: MakeMKV
tools.what: Reads Blu-rays and DVDs. Free while it's in beta.
steps: Download the Mac version, open it and drag MakeMKV into Applications.
Open MakeMKV once. When it asks for a registration key, use the current free beta key from MakeMKV's forum.

tools.name: VLC
tools.what: Plays films from the Library on this Mac. Free.
steps: Download VLC for Mac, open it and drag VLC into Applications.

tools.name: FileBot
tools.what: Not needed: Trans Coded names everything itself. Some people like it for large TV box sets. Use these installers, not the Mac App Store version, which lacks the part Trans Coded uses.
steps: Download the installer that matches this Mac with one of the buttons below. Not sure which? Apple menu › About This Mac: “Chip: Apple M…” means Apple Silicon; “Processor: Intel” means Intel.
Open the downloaded .pkg and follow the installer, then open FileBot once.
